art.title: Penn's Treaty with the Indians
art.why: William Penn, the Quaker founder of Pennsylvania (in the lecture), making peace with the Lenape: liberty of conscience as a colony's foundation. Hicks was a Quaker minister.

art.title: Twenty-two Houses and a Church
art.why: An American village with a church among the houses: worship free in a free country. No church and meeting-house side by side were found.
